item.title: Modder Runs GTA III Inside GTA: San Andreas on an In-Game TV
Natural experiments prove phytoplankton carbon removal works
item.description:
📝 Adding nutrients to the ocean so tiny ocean plants remove carbon dioxide from the atmosphere is an idea that people aren’t used to. That work was published in Science in 2023. Maybe the clearest evidence comes from robotic ocean floats that happened to be sitting in the North Pacific when a Gobi dust cloud rolled over them in 2001.
🔗 Read more: https://www.onepercentbrighter.com/p/natural-experiments-prove-feeding

item.title: Heavy TV watching associated with smaller brain structures, study finds
item.description:
📝 While watching television is linked to smaller brain volume, other types of sedentary activity were not, indicating that what one does while sitting down might matter more than previously understood. The study found that other types of sedentary activities did not have the same associations, indicating that what one does while sitting may matter much more than previously thought. More than two decades later, participants underwent brain MRI.
🔗 Read more: https://dornsife.usc.edu/news/stories/heavy-tv-watching-associated-with-smaller-brain-structures/
